structured_output.title: Certificates with IP commonName get different SANs in v1.18.0
structured_output.content: The environment's manifests include cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate resources, and the certificates.cert-manager.io [v1] CRD is installed. According to the v1.18.0 release notes, an IP address in a certificate's `commonName` field is no longer added to the DNS `subjectAlternativeName` list. It is added to the `ipAddresses` field instead. The environment summary doesn't show what the Certificate specs contain, so check each Certificate's `commonName`. If any contains an IP address, check whether clients or other tools expect that IP to appear as a DNS SAN in the certificates that get issued.
